department: Department of Ocean and Mechanical Engineering

gre_general.value: A GRE score is required, waived only for holders of an FAU Ocean and Mechanical master's.

also.quote: The GRE requirement is waived for applicants who have a Master of Science degree from FAU's Ocean and Mechanical Engineering Department

supervisor.value: The department approves admission rather than a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Approval for admission by the Department of Ocean and Mechanical Engineering

funding.value: The department page does not state funding terms.

entry_route.value: Almost all applicants are expected to hold a master's, though it is not formally required.
entry_route.quote: It is anticipated almost every applicant will already have a master’s degree, but it is not an absolute requirement

notes: The Ocean Engineering PhD (phd-ocean-engineering) is in the same department and is not saved as its own record: it asks for a master's in engineering, science or mathematics, 2 letters, and the GRE. The Mechanical PhD also has Aerospace and Neuroengineering concentrations. Department TOEFL 79 (iBT) and IELTS 6.0 match the university.
